Interface IPayeeAccountClient

Namespace
NuvTools.Payment.Contracts

NuvTools.Payment.dll

The receiving side: an account the platform can pay, and the onboarding that makes it payable.

public interface IPayeeAccountClient

Remarks

A marketplace pays people it has not vetted itself. The provider collects the identity and bank details, decides whether the account may be paid out, and hosts the screens that ask — so none of that reaches the platform, which is the point of using one.
